agentRoles.name: Implementation lead
agentRoles.responsibility: Coordinates scoped changes, reviews, and release evidence.

agentRoles.name: Frontend maintainer
agentRoles.responsibility: Maintains UI, accessibility, browser behavior, and performance.

agentRoles.name: Backend maintainer
agentRoles.responsibility: Maintains APIs, functions, integrations, and service reliability.

agentRoles.name: Security engineer
agentRoles.responsibility: Triages advisories, dependencies, headers, and attack surface.

agentRoles.name: Test engineer
agentRoles.responsibility: Runs build, unit, integration, accessibility, and smoke gates.

agentRoles.name: Product designer
agentRoles.responsibility: Reviews usability, visual consistency, and responsive behavior.

agentRoles.name: Release manager
agentRoles.responsibility: Owns staging validation, immutable promotion, and rollback plans.

agentRoles.name: Observability responder
agentRoles.responsibility: Monitors uptime, deployment health, and redacted error classes.

agentRoles.name: Data privacy steward
agentRoles.responsibility: Enforces no-customer-data access, zero raw retention, and safe alerts.
